'''''Polystichum drepanum''''', also known as '''Madeira shield-fern''',<ref>{{Cite report |url=http://www.iucnredlist.org/details/162178/0 |title=Polystichum drepanum: Christenhusz, M., Bento Elias, R., Dyer, R., Ivanenko, Y., Rouhan, G., Rumsey, F. & Väre, H.: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species 2017: e.T162178A85427290 |last=IUCN |date=2016-05-24 |publisher=International Union for Conservation of Nature |doi=10.2305/iucn.uk.2017-2.rlts.t162178a85427290.en |language=en|doi-access=free }}</ref> is a species of [[fern]] in the [[Dryopteridaceae]] family.
 
It is native to [[Madeira]]. Its natural [[habitat]] is subtropical moist lowland [[Forest|forests]]. It is threatened by [[habitat loss]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Polystichum drepanum (Sw.) C.Presl {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science|url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:17206600-1|access-date=2021-11-20|website=Plants of the World Online|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Polystichum drepanum – The Ferns of Macaronesia|url=https://fernsofmacaronesia.org.uk/home/fern-list/dryopteridaceae/polystichum-drepanum-2/|access-date=2021-11-20|website=fernsofmacaronesia.org.uk}}</ref>

==Taxonomy==
It was first described by [[Olof Swartz]] as ''Aspidium drepanum'' in 1801, and was moved to the genus ''Polystichum'' by [[Carl Borivoj Presl]] in 1836.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Polystichum drepanum (Sw.) C.Presl|url=https://www.gbif.org/species/4039363|access-date=2021-11-20|website=www.gbif.org|language=en}}</ref>
